request: Request: Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, The Bronx, Staten Island, Long Island, New Jersey, Massachusetts open call (Music,

reply.critique: Every ranked listing is open to a non-union NYC performer, and the first four state pay (a starting $125 per show, $200 to $800 a day, $100 per gig, a $700 stipend) with dates and locations. Roulette is the one music call and is a reasonable fifth; the Tiny Cupboard stand-up call and Culture Lab LIC are comparable rolling calls, so nothing clearly better was left out. The Equity-only auditions pay more but are limited to union members, and the Craigslist casting posts are unverified with no pay or dates, so leaving both out is right.
